def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Determine design from 1-shaped silhouette; other colors form palette.
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    # main silhouette is component away from palette strip
    silhouette=[p for p in ones if p[0] < h-4]
    r0=min(r for r,c in silhouette); r1=max(r for r,c in silhouette)
    c0=min(c for r,c in silhouette); c1=max(c for r,c in silhouette)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in silhouette}
    # palette columns in repeated colored strip
    striprow=max(r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0,1) for c in range(w)))
    # Palette columns are the nonzero cells in the repeated bottom band.
    band=[r for r in range(h) if sum(v!=0 for v in grid[r])>=3 and r>r1]
    pr=band[0]
    colors=[grid[pr][c] for c in range(w) if grid[pr][c]!=0]
    # Place each copy in successive vertical slots, preserving silhouette's row spacing.
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dh=r1-r0+1
    start=r0-colors.index(1)*dh
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr,dc in shape:
            rr=start+i*dh+dr; cc=c0+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
